name: 吳建文
objective: This course is to instruct students the basic concepts of financial technology and to enable students to develop innovative applications of financial technology. The contents include the fundamentals of financial technology,  the fundamentals of entrepreneurship, cryptocurrency for financial applications, the blockchain technologies for financial applications, and the artificial intelligence technologies for financial applications.
schedule:
1.	Learn the fundamentals of financial technology and financial information systems
2.	Learn the fundamentals of entrepreneurship
3.	Learn and apply cryptocurrency for financial applications
4.	Learn and apply the blockchain technologies for financial applications
5.	Learn and apply the artificial intelligence technologies for financial applications
materials: The teaching materials, power points, homework will be provided.

課程對應SDGs指標: SDG1：消除貧窮（No Poverty）SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG5：性別平等（Gender Equality）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
